title: Quiz: Python's pathlib Module: Taming the File System
description: Revisit Python's pathlib module for handling file and folder paths consistently across operating systems. Write modern, object-oriented code.
summary: In this quiz, you’ll revisit how to tame the file system with Python’s pathlib module . You’ll reinforce core pathlib concepts, including checking whether a path points to a file and instantiating Path objects.
takeaways: You’ll reinforce core pathlib concepts, including checking whether a path points to a file and instantiating Path objects.
You’ll revisit joining paths with the / operator and .joinpath() , iterating over directory contents with .iterdir() , and renaming files on disk with .replace() .
